_doc: Shared canvas-logic cases (orthogonalRoute.test.ts, 31 vitest tests -> these tables). Rects are [left, top, width, height]; points are [x, y].

chooseSides.name: side by side leaves through facing vertical sides
one below the other leaves through facing horizontal sides
prefers the separating axis over the larger centre delta
falls back to the dominant delta when overlapping on both axes

anchorOf.name: shifted along the side by the lane offset
outer lane clamps back onto the side

assignLanes.name: one arrow gets the centre lane
two arrows between one pair spread symmetrically
opposite directions share the pair and take different lanes
different pairs each keep a centre lane

assignPorts.name: one arrow on a box+side gets the centre port
arrows on the same box+side spread apart even from different pairs

roundedPath.name: straight run is a single line
radius shrinks on a short segment

labelPointOf.name: true arc-length midpoint of a multi-segment line
longest clear segment when the midpoint sits on a box

routeConnector.name: one straight line between horizontally aligned boxes
right-angle elbows when offset on both axes
vertical neighbours run straight between facing sides (the vitest case named 'routes around' never actually wrapped)
genuinely wraps around the nearer outer edge when sides face away (new: closes the gap above)
caption sits on the true arc-length midpoint, not the longest segment
leaves a stub before the first turn

laneSeparation.name: two arrows between one pair draw on different strokes with different captions
two directions of a bidirectional pair separate
each of three lanes keeps its own caption
each lane of a wrapping route takes its own outer line
